The current95e UI delegates to a browser wheel module; current source computes view arcs and positions in Rust, serializes the shapes and calls the HUD page, whose drawWheels uses each share. The historical helper is absent at95e.

Current95e retains an array of LinearVolume and calls sound_output::set_loop_volume for each named layer. Both source versions select the first available environment and ground in their shown update.
observations.remaining: Current audio startup, failed load and scene-selection questions remain in ASSESSMENT-SLOT-AUDIO-LIFECYCLE-95E.json. Source does not establish an actual multi-scene failure or audible output.

existing_finding_connections.first_failed_contract: The configured 100-percent display cutoff is applied before each visible wheel share is independently rounded, so the represented shares can sum to more than one circle for some inputs.
existing_finding_connections.canonical_owner: Wheel arc allocation and quantization at the Rust-to-browser boundary; it is presentation of the existing combat state, not another impairment source.
existing_finding_connections.trace: Current wheel_arcs clips each visible raw segment to remaining and subtracts the unrounded amount, then independently rounds that amount to thousandths. Browser drawWheels advances the angle by each serialized share, without an aggregate cap. Current core derives pain, blood loss, fatigue and other source amounts from transient TacticalCombatState, and the server separately computes projected increases.
existing_finding_connections.symbolic_example: For nonnegative source amounts pain=0.3336, blood_loss=0.3336, fear=0.3328 and zero projected increases, binary32 source-level arithmetic yields displayed shares approximately 0.334,0.334,0.333, totalling about1.001. All exceed the0.005 omission threshold. This repeats the earlier evidence-only arithmetic and invokes no Rust function, serializer, browser, renderer or product behavior.
existing_finding_connections.safeguards: The precise combination has not been shown reachable from an admitted live combat state, and no serialized value, browser rendering or user-visible overdraw was observed. The source retains fixed source order, black fatigue, translucent grey encumbrance, yellow projected increases, and scales total forecasts against available unrounded space. All producer/writer, quantization, serialized finite-value and visual policies remain open. The old6533 painter advanced by clipped unrounded amount; the ff9c root UI differs from6533 and remains separately identified.
existing_finding_connections.prior_attribution: The c100 source finding and its earlier selected ff9c evidence remain unchanged in ASSESSMENT-L1-WHEEL-CUTOFF.json and frozen predecessor ledger entry31. Current95e relevant source bytes match c100, but this assessment records explicit source inspection rather than silently relabeling predecessor work. Segovb564–565 original6533 Lens12 reviews are separately attributed.
